name: CollectorCompleteTask_WithoutImages_CurrentBehaviourIsPermissive
description: TC-UPLOAD-008b [SRS GAP]: SRS §3.5 requires at least 1 evidence image when completing a task. This test DOCUMENTS the current permissive behaviour (no image = accepted). Expected: SaveFileAsync is never called when no images provided — no exception from service layer. Action required: Either enforce image requirement in CompleteTask controller or update SRS.
